rawContent: #TaoFu Joker says: "If you were trying to scare someone silent, would you tell them you are with the CIA or that you have government officials on your payroll so they'd fear everyone?"  #TaoFu @charliesheen says: "No, but I have an idea who might...."  #TaoFu @CIA says: "#MeToo."

#TaoFu Harvey Dent says: "In what sense?  Do you think people should be locked up without a court order/due process and no right to trial before sentencing?"  #TaoFu Joker says: "Absolutely not.  I'll fight to the death anyone who tries to do it too."  #MeToo

#TaoFu Riddler says: "I'm so far from perfect, people often mistake me for it.  Who am I?"  #TaoFu Joker says: "Is it the "?" mark?"  #TaoFu @charliesheen says: "Me."  #TaoFu @CrispinGlover says: "#MeToo."  #TaoFu @NotTheTimCurry says: "Certainly NOT me."

#TaoFu Joker says: "Hey @lesuknight, does this help?  See screenshots."  #TaoFu @NotTheTimCurry says: "@MontyPython gets it."  #TaoFu @charliesheen says: "Best of Twitter Threads..."  #TaoFu Joker says: "Thanks to me."  #TaoFu @CrispinGlover says: "And, #MeToo." https://t.co/MYIoxywu7k
